:[Megan is standing in front of a chart, with a diagram of Voyager 1 and a line graph going downward. She is holding a pointer towards the plot while addressing a panel in front of her to the right. The panel is seated behind a desk and is composed of Ponytail, Cueball and Hairy (who is identified in the dialogue as Greg). Cueball is resting his hands on the desk.]
:Megan: As the radioactive power source on ''Voyager 1'' weakens, we've been turning instruments off to conserve power.

:[Megan is holding the pointer at her side. Cueball is no longer resting his hands on the desk.]
:Megan: Only two instruments remain. Do we want to lose the plasma wave subsystem or the magnetometer?

:[Ponytail has her hand raised. Greg is standing up with his hands on the desk.]
:Ponytail: You know, if we just turned off Greg's LED underlighting–
:Greg: Absolutely not.
:Cueball: Dammit, Greg.
:Greg: I will '''''not''''' allow us to look uncool in front of aliens.
